stance_basis: explicitly objected to Airport Spur and relocation of Grange Avenue in both oral testimony and written comment
summary: Garabed Marcarian, a private citizen from South Milwaukee, opposed the Airport Spur project on the grounds that existing routes via College and Layton Avenues were sufficient. He also raised a specific concern that the relocation of Grange Avenue at 6th Street was depicted incorrectly on the hearing sketch. His objections appear both as oral testimony (Witness #25) and as a written comment (Witness #34).
complaint_summary: Marcarian testified that the Airport Spur is unnecessary because College and Layton Avenues can be used, and that the relocation of Grange Avenue at 6th Street was shown incorrectly on the sketch distributed at the hearing.
summary_quote: Objected to both Airport Spur and relocation of Grange Avenue commencing west of 6th Street.
